units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 48b:9">B. Bath. 48ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 19b:5">Keth. 19ᵇ</cite> if witnesses say <he>א׳ היו דברינו</he> our statement (over our signatures as to having seen the loan handed over) was a matter of trust (that the negotiation would be consummated afterwards).
<cite ref="Ketubot 19b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>שטר א׳</he> a bill of indebtedness signed on trust (that the loan would be consummated subsequently).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 63a:6">B. Mets. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ בפירות</he> advanced payment at present prices for future delivery; <he>א׳ בדמים</he> with the option of paying the difference.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:9">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> end, <he>שמר א׳</he> to deal in good faith with.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 5:8">Tosef. B. Bath. V, 8</cite> <he>אֲמָנַת המדות</he> honesty in measures.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 49a:9">B. Mets. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>מחוסרי א׳</he> (the way of) those lacking honesty (unfair dealing); <cite ref="Bekhorot 13b:14">Bekh. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>מחוסר א׳</he>; a. fr.

R. s. 32</cite> <he>מחוסר א׳</he> same; a. fr. Cmp. <cite ref="A02001"><he>אֱמוּנָה</he></cite>, <cite ref="E00017"><he>הַאֲמָנָה</he></cite>.
